meta.title: HOI AN, VIETNAM: A No-Fluff Travel Guide (2026)
meta.description:
If planning your trip to Vietnam feels overwhelming, get in touch with our friend Adam! He's been a tour guide all over Vietnam and is currently based in Hoi An. Check out his tours: https://www.authenticadventuresbyadam.com

The ESIM CARD we use when we travel: https://etravelsim.com?aff=380

comments.text: I work for a big brand that produces in Vietnam and I can say with confidence that all the products at the market are fake.. They are not from the original brand and they are most likely produced in China under horrendous conditions and with cheap raw material. So think twice when you see a 'bargain' at the market
